result.title: A Closed-Form Temporal Readout for Surgical Triplet Recognition
result.summary: Surgical triplet recognition requires identifying which instrument performs which action on which anatomical target, and following these interactions as they unfold over time. The task is challenging because several triplets can occur at once, their components span very different durations, and the evidence for an interaction is rarely complete in a single frame. We introduce STRIDE, a post-hoc temporal readout that adds temporal context to any trained recogniser. It averages the recogniser's features and logits over a few fixed temporal windows and combines them with the current frame through ridge regression, solved in closed form on a CPU. Applied as a plug-and-play readout to nine existing methods, STRIDE improves $AP_{IVT}$ in 24 of 27 method-dataset pairs, by up to 7.4 points. Moreover, we propose a simple pipeline consisting of an adapted foundation vision encoder with a linear classifier and STRIDE. Across thirteen encoders, STRIDE improves 37 of 39 encoder-dataset pairs by up to 7.2 points. STRIDE reduces false alarms by 41%, at the cost of a slower response at interaction boundaries. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 STRIDE：在已训练的手术三元组识别器之后加一个后处理时序读出，对多个固定时间窗内的特征与 logits 取平均，再用岭回归在当前帧上闭式求解融合，从而在不重训模型的情况下提升识别并降低误报。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多时间尺度池化 + 闭式回归读出」及响应延迟与误报的权衡，可能为 LVR 中累积历史证据、决定何时停止或回看的多窗口状态读出提供轻量实现线索，需核查该读出是否只做后处理而无法影响内部表示。
